biotools.summary: PhenoScreen is a deep learning framework and webserver for phenotypic drug discovery that leverages contrastive learning to connect chemical and cellular morphological profiles, enabling accurate prediction of compound-induced phenotypic changes and identification of novel therapeutic pathways.
